#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify the mechanical refactor of crates/mlt_rules/src/unsupported.rs
into crates/mlt_rules/src/unsupported/ (one file per check).

Checks:
  1. Each moved method body is identical to the original except for a
     `pub(crate) ` prefix on the `fn` line.
  2. Each of the 13 check IDs appears exactly once across unsupported/.
  3. Dispatch references (impl Rule::check match arms) match the original.
  4. Moved-test count matches (22 total, per-file split).
  5. Each moved test body is identical to the original.
"""
import difflib
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/home/watermarkhu/repositories/mlt")
ORIG = ROOT / "crates/mlt_rules/src/unsupported.rs"
NEW_DIR = ROOT / "crates/mlt_rules/src/unsupported"

CHECK_IDS = [
    "MCADE", "AWTIUD", "AXCHUD", "FEATUD", "FNDPUD", "HGCNUD", "IMPKG",
    "ISMBUD", "MIPKG", "SEPTUD", "SYDEUD", "UIRSUD", "UISUUD",
]

orig = ORIG.read_text()
new_mod = (NEW_DIR / "mod.rs").read_text()
new_fc = (NEW_DIR / "check_function_call.rs").read_text()
new_cmd = (NEW_DIR / "check_command.rs").read_text()

fails = []


def brace_span(text, start_idx):
    depth = 0
    i = start_idx
    while i < len(text):
        if text[i] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif text[i] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return i + 1
        i += 1
    raise RuntimeError("unbalanced braces")


def extract_method(text, name):
    m = re.search(rf"^\s*(?:pub\(crate\)\s+)?fn {name}\b", text, re.M)
    assert m, f"fn {name} not found"
    fn_start = m.start()
    line_start = text.rfind("\n", 0, fn_start) + 1
    cur = line_start
    head = line_start
    while cur > 0:
        prev_line_end = text.rfind("\n", 0, cur - 1)
        prev_line = text[prev_line_end + 1:cur]
        s = prev_line.strip()
        if s.startswith("///") or s.startswith("#[") or s == "":
            cur = prev_line_end + 1
            head = cur
        else:
            break
    brace = text.index("{", fn_start)
    end = brace_span(text, brace)
    return text[head:end]


def extract_tests(text):
    out = {}
    for m in re.finditer(r"^\s*fn (\w+)\s*\([^)]*\)\s*\{", text, re.M):
        name = m.group(1)
        brace = text.index("{", m.start())
        end = brace_span(text, brace)
        out[name] = text[m.start():end]
    return out


def norm(body):
    body = body.replace("pub(crate) fn", "fn")
    body = re.sub(r"\s+$", "", body, flags=re.M)
    return body.strip()


# ---- 1. Method bodies identical except `pub(crate)` -------------------------
for name, new_text in [("check_function_call", new_fc), ("check_command", new_cmd)]:
    o, n = norm(extract_method(orig, name)), norm(extract_method(new_text, name))
    if o == n:
        print(f"[PASS] method body identical (modulo `pub(crate)`): {name}")
    else:
        fails.append(f"method body differs: {name}")
        print(f"[FAIL] method body differs: {name}")
        for line in difflib.unified_diff(o.splitlines(), n.splitlines(), "orig", "new", lineterm=""):
            print("   " + line)

# ---- 2. Each check ID appears exactly once across unsupported/ --------------
ok = True
for cid in CHECK_IDS:
    in_check = [p for p in sorted(NEW_DIR.glob("check_*.rs")) if f'"{cid}"' in p.read_text()]
    in_mod = f'"{cid}"' in new_mod
    if not in_mod:
        ok = False
        fails.append(f"check ID {cid}: missing from mod.rs metadata")
    if len(in_check) != 1:
        ok = False
        fails.append(f"check ID {cid}: dispatch appears in {len(in_check)} check files: {[p.name for p in in_check]}")
    else:
        non_test = in_check[0].read_text().split("#[cfg(test)]")[0]
        n = len(re.findall(rf'"{cid}"', non_test))
        if n != 2:
            ok = False
            fails.append(f"check ID {cid}: non-test dispatch occurrences in {in_check[0].name} = {n} (expected 2: is_enabled + make_diag)")
if ok:
    print("[PASS] each check ID dispatch appears in exactly one file; metadata present in mod.rs")
else:
    print("[FAIL] check ID placement issues")

# ---- 3. Dispatch references match -------------------------------------------
def extract_dispatch(text):
    m = re.search(r"fn check\(&self, ctx: &NodeContext\) -> Vec<Diagnostic> \{(.*?)\n    \}", text, re.S)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", m.group(1)).strip()

o, n = extract_dispatch(orig), extract_dispatch(new_mod)
if o == n:
    print("[PASS] dispatch (impl Rule::check) references match original")
else:
    fails.append("dispatch mismatch")
    print("[FAIL] dispatch mismatch")
    print("  orig:", o)
    print("  new :", n)

# ---- 4. Test counts ---------------------------------------------------------
orig_tests = extract_tests(orig)
new_tests = {}
for p in sorted(NEW_DIR.glob("*.rs")):
    new_tests.update(extract_tests(p.read_text()))
print(f"  original tests: {len(orig_tests)}")
print(f"  new tests:      {len(new_tests)}")
print(f"  split: mod.rs={len(extract_tests(new_mod))}"
      f" check_function_call={len(extract_tests(new_fc))}"
      f" check_command={len(extract_tests(new_cmd))}")
if len(orig_tests) != len(new_tests):
    fails.append(f"test count mismatch: orig={len(orig_tests)} new={len(new_tests)}")
else:
    print("[PASS] total test count matches (22)")

# ---- 5. Each moved test body identical --------------------------------------
missing = set(orig_tests) - set(new_tests)
extra = set(new_tests) - set(orig_tests)
if missing or extra:
    fails.append(f"test name mismatch: missing={missing} extra={extra}")
    print(f"[FAIL] test name mismatch: missing={missing} extra={extra}")
else:
    diffs = 0
    for name, body in orig_tests.items():
        if norm(body) != norm(new_tests[name]):
            diffs += 1
            fails.append(f"test body differs: {name}")
            print(f"[FAIL] test body differs: {name}")
    if diffs == 0:
        print("[PASS] all 22 test bodies identical to original")

print()
if fails:
    print(f"VERIFICATION FAILED ({len(fails)} issues)")
    for f in fails:
        print("  -", f)
    sys.exit(1)
print("ALL VERIFICATIONS PASSED")
